image_policy: Catalogue source-page images are retained and referenced by product. No technical value is invented where the catalogue does not state one.

products.name_tr: Sert Şeker İçin Sürekli Pişirici ve Vakumlu Makina
products.details: Automatic continuous cooking with vacuum system for hard candy; easy to use, durable stainless-steel structure, easy to clean, suitable for all kinds of candies, high-temperature cooking, flexible cooking temperature, controllable vacuum and batch weight.

Continuously cooks syrup prepared by a pre-cooker or other process to the desired temperature for subsequent processing; suitable for soft/hard candy, jelly, syrup, date syrup, condensed milk and cotton-candy syrup.
Batch cooking for toffee, caramel, chewy candies, jellies, marmalade and filling syrups; double-jacket steam cooker, stainless steel, optional vacuum and hot-oil cooking.

Cooks and aerates nougat syrup to feed a slab drum line; double-jacket stainless-steel tanks with coil, different sizes; can prepare/store invert sugar, gelatin/starch, caramel, condensed milk and jelly syrups.

products.name_en: Double Jacketed Stainless Steel Tanks (with Coil)
products.name_tr: Çift Cidarlı Coil (Bobinli) Paslanmaz Çelik Tanklar
products.details: Double-jacket stainless-steel tanks with coil, available in different sizes; for preparation/storage/feeding of invert sugar, gelatin and starch, caramel, condensed milk and jelly.
PLC and load-cell equipped machine for automatic raw-material weighing per batch; formulas can be stored in PLC memory for repeatable syrup preparation.

products.name_tr: Çikolata Kaplama Makinesi (Enrober) ve Soğutma Tüneli
products.details: Coats whole products or only the bottom with chocolate and cools coated products. Adjustable chocolate pump and stainless-steel rod-network belt. Enrober widths 62, 85, 105, 125 cm; cooling tunnels can be made in different lengths/widths; decorator can be mounted; moving/removable tub can be designed on request.
Decorator for applying decorative chocolate patterns/colors; shown integrated with enrober equipment.

products.name_tr: Laboratuvar İçin Kaplama Makinesi ve Soğutma Tüneli
products.details: Laboratory-scale chocolate coating and cooling equipment presented in the catalogue.

Produces Smart beans/chocolate dragees in different sizes. Includes Smart forming machine, ice-bank system, 7 m cooling tunnel, sieve drum, chocolate storage tank with transfer/circulation pump and coating pans.
products.capacity: about 70–120 kg/h depending on bean size

products.details: Produces bars with nougat, coconut or date paste with chocolate coating. Includes cooking system/cold tables, coconut-paste mixer, extruder, first 7.5 m cooling tunnel, guillotine, enrober, decorator and second 14 m cooling tunnel. Can be configured for chocolate-paste bars.

products.name_en: Cereal and Nut Bar Production Line
products.name_tr: Kuru Yemiş, Kuruyemiş, Tahıl ve Protein Bar Üretim Hattı
products.details: Line for cereal, protein, nut and dried-fruit bars. Catalogue describes configurable dimensions and coating with chocolate coating and decoration.

products.name_en: ChocoBar Cereal Bar Line with Caramel Layer
products.name_tr: Karamel Katmanlı ChocoBar ve Cereal Bar Üretim Hattı
products.details: Complete line for cereal bars with a caramel layer followed by chocolate coating; product dimensions and configuration determine capacity.

products.name_en: ChocoBar Coconut, Date and Nougat Paste with Caramel Layer
products.name_tr: Hindistan Cevizi, Hurma ve Nugat Ezmeli Karamel Katmanlı ChocoBar Hattı
products.details: ChocoBar line for coconut, date and nougat paste products with caramel layer and chocolate coating.
products.capacity: approx. 10,000–18,000 pieces/h depending on product dimensions

products.name_en: Choco Bar Line (Slab Former Drum System)
products.name_tr: Choco Bar Hattı (Hamura Levha Şekli Veren Tambur Sistemli)
products.details: Produces chocolate bars with single-layer nougat, two-layer nougat/caramel bars and other configurations. Includes nougat cooking and aeration system and slab forming drum; after forming, product is cooled by chocolate coating and cooling systems.
Fondant beater machine for preparing fondant cream for toffee, center of chocolate and candy kinds of fondant.

Laboratory batch cooker for different kinds of toffees, caramels, chewy candies, jellies, marmalade and syrups; double-jacket steam cooker with stainless-steel body and automatic steam stop/control options.
Laboratory ball mill for producing chocolate with circulation pump and complete electrical system.
Laboratory conch used for better chocolate refining.
Laboratory chocolate storage tank for storing finished chocolate.
Grinding machine used for grinding broken sandwich wafers into a suitable paste for wafer production.
Turbo mixer for mixing various types of powders in liquids.
Preparing/tempering mixer for caramel dough.

products.name_en: Grinding Machine for Hard Candy Scraps
products.name_tr: Sert Şeker Iskartaları İçin Öğütme Makinesi
products.details: Grinding machine for caramel/croquant and hard-candy scraps, producing material suitable for mixing with other products.
Ball mill machine for chocolate production, with cooling system, circulation pump and electrical/PLC system.

products.name_en: Chocolate Production System by Ball Mill with Automatic Pre-Mixer
products.name_tr: Otomatik Ön Mikserli Bilyalı Değirmenle Çikolata Üretim Sistemi
products.details: Integrated chocolate production system with automatic pre-mixer and raw-material weighing capability, followed by ball-mill processing and circulation.
Laboratory blender/mixer for small-batch ingredient mixing.

products.name_en: Croquant Cooking Machine with Direct Flame System
products.name_tr: Doğrudan Alev Sistemi İle Çalışan Krokant Pişirme Makinesi
products.details: Croquant/caramel cooking machine with direct flame system, automatic mixing and discharge; inverter-controlled mixer speed and temperature safety/control.

products.name_en: Cooking and Mixing Machine with Steam System
products.name_tr: Buhar Sistemi İle Pişirme ve Karıştırma Makinesi
products.details: Steam-jacket cooking and mixing machine for confectionery products, with automatic mixing and discharge and adjustable cooking temperature.

products.name_en: Silverson Mixer to Mix Ingredients with High Speed
products.name_tr: Ürünlerin Yüksek Hızda Karışımı İçin Silverson Mikser
products.details: High-speed Silverson mixer with stainless-steel construction and high-speed mixing capability.
Machine for mixing/aerating different kinds of confectionery products for frappe preparation.

products.name_en: Mixer Machine with One Jacket for Sesame and Nuts
products.name_tr: Susam ve Çeşitli Kuruyemişleri Şerbet ile Karıştırmak İçin Tek Cidarlı Karıştırıcı Makinesi
products.details: Single-jacket mixer for mixing sesame and various nuts with syrup.

products.name_en: Mixer for Chocolate and Coconut Paste
products.name_tr: Çikolata ve Hindistan Cevizi Ezmesi İçin Mikser
products.details: Mixer for preparing and mixing chocolate/coconut paste and related confectionery mixtures.
Jacketed storage tank for reserving and storing chocolate; equipped with controlled mixing and temperature control, with pump options for transfer/circulation.
Laboratory forming equipment for gum products.
Complete dragee gum production line including forming machine, cooling tunnel and related equipment.
Laboratory coating pan for coating and polishing products; stainless-steel construction with adjustable operating speed and optional hot/cold air system.
Coating pan for chocolate dragee, gum and nut products; stainless or copper pan options, inverter control and hot/cold air options.
Movable coating-pan equipment for dragee and chocolate coating applications.
Automatic chocolate dragee coating system with jacketed chocolate pan, chocolate piping/transfer equipment, electrical panel and pneumatic chocolate showering nozzle.
Halva cooking and aeration system with continuous cooking, different parts, cooling system and PLC system; designed for syrup and final halva production.
products.capacity: about 400 kg/h syrup; about 800 kg/h final halva

products.details: Halva forming line for forming ready halva paste, with cooling tunnel and guillotine for producing desired lengths.
